name: Palace (Karma, Shed)
description: Palace is a shedding game with a three-layer setup: hand cards, face-up palace cards, and face-down cards. Play cards equal to or higher than the pile top; 2s reset, 10s burn the pile. Last player with cards loses.

overview.description: Palace is a shedding game with a three-layer setup: hand cards, face-up palace cards, and face-down cards. Play cards equal to or higher than the pile top; 2s reset, 10s burn the pile. Last player with cards loses.

setup.deck: Standard 52 cards. Rank: 2 (special) > A > K > Q > J > 10... > 3.
setup.dealing: Each player gets 3 face-down, 3 face-up on top, and 3 hand cards. May swap hand with face-up before play.

rules.objective: Get rid of all cards. Last player with cards loses.
rules.gameplay: 1. **Setup**: 3 face-down, 3 face-up, 3 hand. Swap hand with face-up if desired. 2. **Play**: Play card or set equal to or higher than pile top. Draw to refill hand to 3 until stock empty. 3. **Pick up**: Cannot play â†’ take entire pile. 4. **Layers**: Empty hand first, then face-up, then blind-flip face-down. 5. **2**: Resets pile; next player can play anything. 6. **10**: Burns pile; same player plays again. 7. **Four-of-a-kind**: Burns pile; same player plays again.
keyRules: 2: Resets pile; next player can play any card.
10: Burns (clears) pile; same player plays again.
Four-of-a-kind: Burns pile; same player plays again.
Must empty hand before face-up, face-up before face-down.
Blind flip: if unplayable, pick up pile including flipped card.

strategy.basic: Put 2s, 10s, and Aces in face-up slots. Shed small cards early.
strategy.intermediate: Sometimes take a small pile if it contains useful cards. Save 10s for huge piles.
strategy.advanced: Block opponents with face-up cards. Force pickups when they are on face-down.
tips: Save 10s for when the pile is huge.
Don't rush to empty face-up cards without a 2 as backup.
